#define CAST_OBJ_NOTNULL(to, from, type_magic)				\ /* <=== include/miniobj.h:61:66:CAST_OBJ_NOTNULL:3 */ 
	do {								\
		(to) = (from);						\
		AN((to));						\
		CHECK_OBJ((to), (type_magic));				\
	} while (0)

#define	VTAILQ_INSERT_TAIL(head, elm, field) do {			\ /* <=== include/vqueue.h:530:535:VTAILQ_INSERT_TAIL:3 */ 
	VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field) = NULL;				\
	(elm)->field.vtqe_prev = (head)->vtqh_last;			\
	*(head)->vtqh_last = (elm);					\
	(head)->vtqh_last = &VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field);			\
} while (0)

		assert((ptr)->magic == type_magic);			\
	} while (0)

#define	VTAILQ_REMOVE(head, elm, field) do {				\ /* <=== include/vqueue.h:545:555:VTAILQ_REMOVE:3 */ 
	if ((VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field)) != NULL)			\
		VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field)->field.vtqe_prev =		\
		    (elm)->field.vtqe_prev;				\
	else {								\
		(head)->vtqh_last = (elm)->field.vtqe_prev;		\
	}								\
	*(elm)->field.vtqe_prev = VTAILQ_NEXT((elm), field);		\
	TRASHIT(*oldnext);						\

} while (0)
